definition.simple: A traditional watering system where a cow walks in a circle to turn a wheel that pulls up buckets of water.
definition.academic: A traditional method of irrigation using a system of pulleys and an endless chain of buckets, driven by draft animals (like oxen) to draw water from an open well.

examples: An ox pulling a lever that rotates a gear, fetching water continuously.

common_misconceptions: Rahat uses electricity or modern machinery.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Compare the Rahat system to riding a bicycle where turning one gear turns the chain.
